sources.entry: IT-Tools by sharevb - Collection of handy online tools for developers (fork of it-tools). (Demo) GPL-3.0 Docker
IT-Tools | Collection of handy online tools for developers

summary.one_liner: A web app bundling many handy online tools for developers and IT workers, which can also be self-hosted in Docker.
summary.what_it_does: IT-Tools is a collection of utility tools aimed at developers and people working in IT, offered as a web application. The README does not list individual tools, so specific functions are not described here. The project can be run locally for development with pnpm, which provides hot-reload, production builds, unit tests with Vitest, and ESLint linting. It includes a script that generates boilerplate for a new tool inside src/tools. The README points to the issue tracker for planned features and roadmap items.
use_cases: Self-host a set of developer utilities on a homelab
Run handy IT and developer tools in a browser
Contribute a new tool to an online developer toolbox
Deploy a containerized utility website with Docker
notable: Self-hostable via Docker images on Docker Hub and GitHub Container Registry
Other self-host options named: Cloudron, Tipi, Unraid
Includes a generator script to scaffold new tools
Uses i18n with locale files for translations
Continuously deployed on Vercel according to the README
caveats: Feature list is not given in the README; the roadmap is tracked in the issues
Development setup requires a VSCode/Volar-based editor configuration for best type support
